That would be a founder decision"; D-002:67; D-002:135

If S-05 makes them methods behind the boundary, their outcomes add values to the vocabularies, an evidence level, and a custodian for value the seller owes, which widens the custodian from money held to value owed. proposed_wording: The values inside the elements are vocabularies: attempt states, outcome kinds, reason categories, evidence levels, custodians, verdicts and capabilities. A value is added with the feature that needs it, and the order side learns it before it crosses. An added value never changes what an existing one means.
note: interpretation: it changes the substance, not only the wording. Consequence 1 claims growth of capabilities only; this paragraph also opens states, kinds and reason categories, which the order side reads to derive the payment status, and adds a rule later subjects inherit. Its list also leaves out custodians, which the stored-value item grows.

claim: A new provider, or one cut off, changes only what is behind the boundary; so does a new method unless it can do something new

A new method or provider that needs a value the order side doesn't yet know, a capability, state, kind, reason or evidence level, makes the order side gain the feature that reads it, and that vocabulary grows (How it grows).
note: The bullet states without condition what the record's own Leaves open and Gaps leave unproven.
